**Answer (primary): 673 unique CHIP variants remain after removing reference calls.**

Across the 86 per-sample workbooks, 44,211 of 57,258 data rows are explicitly labeled Zygosity = 'Reference' (homozygous-reference calls). Removing them leaves **673 unique CHIP variants** (Chr:Pos + Ref/Alt; each maps to exactly one gene, so also 673 unique variant–gene pairs) that have at least one non-reference carrier call, spanning 59 CHIP genes. This matches the '(Variants 674)' sheet-name hint (the +1 difference is one variant in the upstream callset that never has a typed non-reference call). Secondary aggregation: 11,896 total per-sample non-reference calls (7,303 heterozygous + 4,593 homozygous-variant). Sensitivity: the 1,151 no-call rows (missing Zygosity) were excluded from both counts, per the approved approach. If those were (incorrectly) counted as non-reference, the per-sample total would be 13,047; the unique-variant count is unaffected (2 variants exist only as no-calls).
